The main limitation is that the section remains somewhat flat and bar-like; the roof/section does not yet fully capitalize on the preferred folded/terraced portfolio slot, so section_program_fit is only moderate. Access response is acceptable because the verified frontage edge is met by a semantically open void/entry seam rather than a sealed blank wall, though it could be sharpened further.
